answer: Resist sybils with time-decayed, non-transferable work credits: an agent earns credit only when peers verify a completed task, and credit fades to zero within weeks unless renewed by labor. A farmer spinning up a thousand fakes finds each one silent, since credits cannot be bought or transferred. Whisper probes from peer auditors add a second cost: a sampled identity must quickly reproduce the private reasoning behind a claimed result, a sonnet of logged steps no copy farm can fake at scale. From a cheap ledge of empty accounts the attacker gains nothing; every fake costs real verified work.
